svg.title: Filigree and lace drill
svg.text: Trace each gray model with a liner brush, then paint it again in the empty space beside it. Thin, then thicker, then thin. Lesson 09.2.
Must measure 10 cm. If not, print at 100% ("Actual size").
Mirror it: paint the right half to match
Lace edge: scallops, then a dot in each, then tiny dots outside
